comments.body:
This may need to be a two-step process if the resource is not already an fcrepo:VersionedResource.

 
curl -XPOST -H"Slug: new" -H"Link: <http://fedora.info/definitions/fcrepo#VersionedResource>; rel=\"type\"" "http://localhost:8080/rest/"
And: https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2617
The above comment no longer applies.  Please ignore.  The concern mentioned is addressed by the FCREPO-2767 Closed .

Danny Bernstein I think Andrew Woods's comment may still apply because if you create some resources via the REST interface then they can still be viewed and accessed via the HTML UI and will still stacktrace.

I'll take this one and see if we can't just check for the OriginalResource header to enable or disable the Create Version button.
